## Overview

This official Ogma example demonstrates custom keyboard navigation, graph traversal and visual focus using Ogma events and styling APIs. RPT-0006 uses it only as accessibility coverage evidence for a commercial graph SDK.

Informs DEC-006 and R-014 without accepting a decision.

## Limits

The example uses custom application code and is not proof of end-to-end tmodel accessibility. Ogma is commercial, requires an access key for installation, and licensing/deployment terms need scenario-specific review.
